name: FrameAssembly
description: A Domain-Specific Language (DSL), optimizing compiler, and PCAP-to-.fasm decompiler written in Rust 2024 that compiles strict-lowercase network packet code (.fasm) into deterministic, nanosecond-precision PCAPNG (.pcap / .pcapng) packet captures—and decompiles .pcap / .pcapng captures back into canonical .fasm code (bidirectional .fasm <-> .pcap/.pcapng compilation and decompilation)—across 81 native Layer 2 through Layer 7 protocols (2,611 verified .fasm corpus scenarios).
